rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.King Crim: Health limits for King Crimson's and Doppio's barrage.

Above this share of max health (0.0 to 1.0) a resolve 3+ user cannot use Doppio's barrage.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.King Crim: When Ground Punch turns into Desperate Eye Jab, and its cooldown.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.desperate: Below this share of max health (0.0 to 1.0) Ground Punch is replaced by Desperate Eyejab.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.King Crim: Impale's cooldown and the Gaping Wound it inflicts.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.impaleGap: Gaping Wound amplifier applied by Impale (0 = level 1, 1 = level 2, ...).
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.King Crim: Throw Projectile's cooldown and the items it may throw.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.projectil: Projectile Throw cooldown in ticks (the triple throw shares it).
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.allowedPr: Comma-separated item ids Projectile Throw may throw; arrows are always allowed. Only items King Crimson knows how to throw count. "jojo:" is read as the core namespace.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphSt: Stamina one Epitaph costs, taken at the press.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphPl: Stamina one Epitaph costs when a player is under the crosshair, taken at the press. A rider and what he rides are one target at one cost. The foreseen fight is paid on top of it, action by action: with the default, one use takes about 40 to 50 percent of a base stamina bar in all.
Epitaph cooldown in seconds after a press with a player under the crosshair.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphEn: Whether Epitaph foresees at all. Off, the ability is refused.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphMa: The longest foresight in seconds, reached at Resolve 4. Resolve 0 and 1 see 0.1 of it, Resolve 2 sees 0.3, Resolve 3 sees 0.6.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphRa: Blocks around the user within which creatures hunting him are foreseen; the crosshair reaches as far.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphMu: With several players online nobody slows and the phantoms run ahead instead: they live the whole foresight in this share of the single player phantom phase. 0.25 is four times as fast.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphPh: Whether the one who foresees also hears what the phantoms would sound like. Off, the foreseen future is silent.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphUs: Whether the one who foresees is walked along his own foreseen track from the press, so that what he is shown is what happens; Time Erase frees him. Off, he keeps control, and nothing that was foreseen of him or for him happens.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphSt: Whether the Time Erase step frees the one who foresees from his foreseen track, as an erase does. Off, the step is refused while he is walked.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphRe: Release at a Blow That No Longer Lands
After the one who foresees has erased time, a creature still walks the track his foreseen blows shaped, though those blows no longer land. On, it is let go at the first such blow and decides anew.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphFo: Whether a player foreseen to die dies at that tick even when the real blow leaves him alive. Off, he takes the foreseen blow for real and what is really on him decides.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphPu: With several players online and a player under the crosshair: on, everyone who is foreseen plays on while the phantoms run ahead, and is then put back exactly as he was at the press, inventory included, and walked along what was foreseen. What he sets off through redstone in that time (pistons, dispensers) is not undone. It cannot be proven safe against every mod that keeps items in a place of its own; each pull-back is written to the server log. Off, that player is walked from the press and nothing is undone.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphSi: Milliseconds of a server tick a prediction may spend running ahead. Past it the phantoms run slower instead of the server.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphMa: The most entities one Epitaph foresees, the nearest first; the one under the crosshair is always in.
The most entities that first appear inside one prediction (arrows shot, items dropped) and are foreseen too. Past it they still appear when their time comes, unforeseen.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphDe: Comma-separated entity type ids Epitaph never foresees. A mod id alone, or modid:*, leaves out every entity of that mod.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphVe: Troubleshooting: check every entity a prediction is handed and leave out what is not its own. Turn it on if another mod makes foreseen creatures react to real ones.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphTr: Troubleshooting: carry a foreseen creature along its track through anything that was put on it, without the short cut past it.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.epitaphCh: Blocks per tick, at least, by which a foreseen creature knocked off its track comes back to it.
Share of its distance from its track by which a foreseen creature comes back each tick, when that is more than the least.
Blocks off its track past which a foreseen creature appears back on it at once.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.King Crim: Time Erase's duration, cooldown and stamina cost.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.timeErase: Time Erase Limit
The longest Time Erase in seconds, reached at Resolve 4. Resolve 3 gets 0.6 of it.
Time Erase Camera Shake
A slight shake of your own camera while the ground breaks at the start of your Time Erase. It scales with Screen Effects in the Accessibility settings.
Time Erase Cooldown
Time Erase cooldown in ticks when timeEraseDynamicCooldown is off.
Time Erase Dynamic Cooldown

Whether the cooldown of Time Erase grows with how long the erase ran, as a time stop's does: the ticks it ran times timeEraseDynamicCooldownMultiplier, at least timeEraseDynamicMinimumCooldown. Off: always timeEraseCooldown. A third of it in Resolve.
Dynamic Cooldown Multiplier
Cooldown ticks for each tick a Time Erase ran, with timeEraseDynamicCooldown on. A time stop waits 3.
Dynamic Minimum Cooldown
The shortest cooldown of Time Erase in ticks, with timeEraseDynamicCooldown on.
Time Erase Stamina per Tick
Stamina Time Erase costs per tick. Its user regenerates no stamina while it runs, and an erase that ends early gives back the unused share of its start.
Shift Other Players
Whether the eraser sees other players ahead of where they are, more so the further they move, and they are put there when the Time Erase ends.
Shift per Block Moved
Blocks another player's image runs ahead for each block he moves during a Time Erase.
Creatures Shifted per Player

With more than one player online: how many of the creatures nearest to each player a Time Erase shifts the way it shifts players, drawn at random among twice as many. 0 shifts no creature. Needs Shift Other Players.
Creatures' Pause after an Erase
Seconds the creatures around stop thinking when a full Time Erase at Resolve 4 ends. A shorter erase gives the same share of it. 0 turns it off.
Creatures Never Paused
Comma-separated entity type ids the end of a Time Erase never pauses.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.King Crim: The passive skill: a heavy hit is escaped by a short Time Erase, a killing hit by a longer one.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.reflexEra: The passive skill: a heavy hit is escaped by a short Time Erase, a killing hit by a longer one.
A hit that would take more than this share of max health (0.0 to 1.0) sets off the reflex.
Stamina the reflex costs. Without it the hit lands.
Seconds the reflex's Time Erase lasts, never longer than the user's own limit.
Seconds before the reflex can go off again. With the client setting No Stand ability cooldowns on it does not wait: a repeat within this time costs extra stamina instead.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.lastChanc: At or below this share of max health (0.0 to 1.0) any hit sets off the last chance, as a killing hit does.
Seconds the last chance's Time Erase lasts, never longer than the user's own limit.
Seconds before the last chance can go off again; it costs nothing. It waits this long with the client setting No Stand ability cooldowns on as well.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.King Crim: What Blood Throw costs its user, and how long it waits.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.bloodThro: Health Blood Throw takes from its user; it never takes the last point.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.King Crim: How far a Time Erase Step reaches.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.timeErase: Step Reach Limit
The furthest a Time Erase Step reaches, in blocks. Below it the reach is what the user walks in his own longest Time Erase.
rotp_kingcrimson.configuration.timeSkipD: Ticks one Time Skip moves the world ahead (high values stutter the game).
